title: No race for this route
heading: No race for this route
lead: You followed the race-weather link in Cairn, but none of your races uses this route: none was pushed to this Cairn trip, and none has its GPX imported from it.
how_h: To see this route's race-day weather
how_1: Open the race manager and add a race (or edit the one you have).
how_2: Under "Import a GPX from Cairn", pick this trip or paste its share link.
how_3: From then on the same link in Cairn opens that race's weather directly.
account: Is the race in another account? Sign out, sign in with that one and follow the link from Cairn again.
